title: (RHEA-2014:1282) glusterfs enhancement update
portal_summary:
Updated glusterfs packages that add one enhancement are now available for Red
Hat Storage 3 native client for Red Hat Common.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server from RHUI|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server from RHUI|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Scientific Computing|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Workstation|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Desktop|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to use the Red
Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Storage is software-only, scale-out storage that provides flexible and
affordable unstructured data storage for an enterprise. GlusterFS, a key
building block of Red Hat Storage, is based on a stackable user-space design and
can deliver exceptional performance for diverse workloads. GlusterFS aggregates
various storage servers over network interconnections into one large, parallel
network file system.

This update adds the following enhancement:

* The glusterfs native client packages have been included in the Red Hat Common
channel. (BZ#1119368)

Users of glusterfs are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which add
this enhancement.
